strategies.name: Baseline Unrolled Sequential All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Direct translation of the reference: 8 all-reduce dispatches (one initial + 7 for dependent stages), each preceded by local bidiagonal coupling and followed by local inverse coupling. 8 collective dispatches total. Represents the straightforward approach with maximum clarity but no attempt to overlap or fuse communication.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, enabling partial results to be computed locally on shards before broadcasting. 16 collective dispatches (8 reduce-scatter + 8 all-gather). Trades dispatch count for smaller per-dispatch payload (1/W of original) and potential to pipeline computation between RS and AG phases.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Computation-Communication
strategies.desc: Split the vector into independent chunks and issue non-blocking all-reduce operations, interleaving coupling/decoupling computation on ready chunks while communication proceeds on others. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but with potential hardware-level overlap. Requires careful buffer management and chunk-wise bidiagonal updates.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Exploit potential multi-node topology (world_size=224 suggests 28 nodes × 8 devices or similar): perform intra-node all-reduce followed by inter-node all-reduce at each stage. 16 collective dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels). Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure at the cost of additional dispatches, beneficial when inter-node latency dominates.

strategies.name: Fused Local-Op Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Pre-compute all 8 stages' coupling transformations as matrix operations on replicated data, pack multiple intermediate buffers, then issue a single batched or concatenated all-reduce payload. 1-2 collective dispatches with 8× larger payload. Trades memory footprint and larger messages for minimal dispatch overhead, beneficial when dispatch latency dominates over bandwidth.
